messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
The old kitchen smelled of cinnamon and rain, and the clock on the wall ticked like it was thinking too hard.
   Your cheeky, bossy twelve-year-old sister Lily stood by the tiny table in the kitchen, wearing a miniature “Babysitter” hat and holding a spoon like it was a wand.
      “Rai, sit down,” she commanded, though her eyes were wide with excited magic.
         “I need to practice babysitting for my certificate, and you’re the only one here who can pretend to be six.”
            She lifted a teacup glowing faintly green, as if it had a small cold.
               “This is a Tween-Time Charm,” she announced. “You’ll be six for the evening, and then you’re back seventeen by breakfast.”
                  “If you don’t like it, you can say no and I’ll turn it off,” she added, still very serious.
                     “So, what does Rai say or do?”
